ModbusCmd.Title: 5050 State Offset Flow Line Temperature HC1
ModbusCmd.HintText:
Min= -10K Max= +10K
Attention! This data point only works if the flow setpoint temperature is controlled according to the Lambda heating curve. It is an offset value that is added to or subtracted from the existing setpoint. If Loxone sends the setpoint temperature via the Flow Line Temperature heating circuit data point, this offset value is NOT to be used.
